newsitem.title: czech republic: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - Dec 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - Dec 12.

text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The budget deficit for the end of this year could reach from 3.2 to 5.2 billion crowns. More careful economic measures are being taken by the cabinet, and according to the government, the deficit should not exceed 1.2 billion.
- The losses for mining company Dolu Paskov, about which employees from all four of the company's sites protested last week, will reach approximately 1.5 billion crowns.

- A proposal from Transport Minister Martin Riman on the development of water routes was accepted by the cabinet yesterday. In the next eight years about six billion crowns will be invested into the project.
- Czech satellite Magion 5, which a Russian rocket sent into orbit on August 29 this year, is still misplaced. Magion 4, which was sent out the same month, is on course and in good condition.

- ZPS, a machine manufacturing company in Zlin, could become the first industrial business from the Czech Republic listed in London. The company is aiming for the London Stock Exchange and will probably be backed by the Union Bank of Switzerland.
PRAVO - Despite predictions that total losses from the liquidation of Kreditni Banka Plzen would reach around 4.4 billion crowns, the total is now expected to reach only two billion.

- The first round of technical meetings about Skoda Ostrov supplying trolley buses to San Francisco took place yesterday in the United States. The Czech side, on contract with the Italian company Breda, was represented by Electric Transit Inc from Maryland. San Francisco agreed to take 220 standard and 30 articulated buses.

MLADA FRONTA DNES - Potato producers will request a total of 83 million crowns from the government fund in order to regulate the market. Spokesmen for the Potato Workers' Union explained that an addition of one crown to every kilogramme of potatoes would add 83,000 tonnes to a current production of half a million tonnes.
